source_instruction: i am looking for a women's socks made up of polyester cotton which is washable in machine. also choose black or semi mint rush green color.
query: I stopped by the little community garden plot on my walk over this morning, and the sun-warmed tomato vines were so heavy with fruit that a few of the lower branches had dipped all the way down to brush the crushed clover paths. A tiny golden garden spider had strung a perfect web between two of the cherry tomato stakes, strung with tiny dewdrops that caught the light like scattered sequins when the breeze picked up. One of the regulars who tends the herb beds gave me a crumpled paper bag full of fresh lemon balm, saying it steeps into the nicest iced tea for warm afternoons, and I stuffed it in the side pocket of my canvas tote before heading in. I’ve heard that women’s socks and hosiery made of polyester cotton are safe for machine dry, and that options exist in either black, semi turbo pink, or semi mint rush green. I’ve also heard there are packs of no-show sock liners that pair really nicely with those styles, and that all of these pieces are available in options under 30.
